script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Workplace
Theme: second chances

Begin screenplay.

---

FADE IN:

INT. MORNING COMMUTE TRAIN - DAY

*A train full of tired and frustrated commuters.*

ANNA (mid-30s, disheveled, yet determined) *sits across from a young man, MIKE (late 20s, anxious, restless), who's scrolling through his phone.*

ANNA
(looking at Mike)
You look troubled. Is everything alright?

MIKE
(looking up, surprised)
Oh, hi. I'm Mike. I'm just trying to keep up with the news.

Anna smiles, then leans back in her seat.

ANNA
It's a lot to take in, isn't it?

MIKE
(nods)
And I can't help but feel like I'm behind.

ANNA
(softly)
We all do. But you know, it's never too late to make a change.

MIKE
(skeptical)
How can you be so sure?

ANNA
(smiling)
Because I've been there.

---

INT. REAL ESTATE OFFICE - DAY

*Anna sits at her desk, surrounded by piles of paperwork. Her boss, RICHARD (late 40s, stern, impatient), enters the office.*

RICHARD
Anna, I need you to close the Jones deal today.

ANNA
(nods)
I understand, Richard. I'll make it happen.

---

INT. COFFEE SHOP - NIGHT

*Anna sits alone, engrossed in her laptop, trying to close the deal.*

MIKE (V.O.)
(sighs)
I wish I could focus like that.

---

INT. REAL ESTATE OFFICE - DAY

*Mike enters the office, looking determined.*

MIKE
Hi, I'm Mike. I'd like to apply for an open position.

ANNA
(smiling)
Nice to meet you, Mike. I'll make sure your resume gets to the right person.

---

INT. MIKE'S APARTMENT - NIGHT

*Mike sits in front of his computer, sending out job applications and updating his resume.*

ANNA (V.O.)
(voiceover)
You can do this, Mike.

---

INT. REAL ESTATE OFFICE - DAY

*Anna receives an email from HR, notifying her of Mike's application.*

---

INT. REAL ESTATE OFFICE - AFTERNOON

*Mike and Anna sit across from each other during an interview.*

MIKE
Why do you want to hire me?

ANNA
(smiling)
Because I see potential in you.

---

INT. REAL ESTATE OFFICE - DAY

*Mike starts his first day of work. Anna shows him the ropes.*

---

INT. REAL ESTATE OFFICE - WEEKS LATER

*Anna and Mike work together on a deal, both looking determined and focused.*

---

INT. COFFEE SHOP - NIGHT

*Anna and Mike sit across from each other, sipping coffee.*

ANNA
(smiling)
You've come a long way, Mike.

MIKE
(nods)
I couldn't have done it without you, Anna.

---

INT. REAL ESTATE OFFICE - DAY

*Anna receives a call from Richard, notifying her that they've closed the Jones deal.*

ANNA
(excitedly)
We did it!

MIKE
(smiling)
Together.

---

FADE OUT.

---

THE END.
